title: 第25章 道藏兽珠第26章 杀手毒刃
content_zh:
感受着三足毒蟾的生命气息快速消散，所有人都露出无比震惊的表情。
重伤的萧战更是双眸瞪大，露出了极度惊恐的表情来。
他自己跟三足毒蟾交过手，现场除了江若尘外，他是最为清楚三足毒蟾到底有多强的人。
三足毒蟾虽是通脉境界的修为，可战力却已经半步迈入了气海境界，这也是他败得那么彻底的原因。
可如此强悍的妖兽，竟被江若尘一拳轰杀，毫不拖泥带水……
更恐怖的是，江若尘最后出的那一拳，竟足足轰出了六象之力，这是多么的变态啊！
这一瞬间，他既震惊，又无地自容，想想之前的豪言壮志，简直就是一个笑话！
另一边，解决了三足毒蟾的江若尘快速将尸体挪开，看到了它身子下的东西，是一颗鸡蛋大小，泛着幽幽绿光的珠子。
这是什么？
盯着珠子江若尘没有贸然下手，因为他能感受到，这珠子散发着虽然光芒很好看，却富含毒性，万一沾染就麻烦了。
“果真是毒珠！
你小子运气真是不错。”
老龙声音在此时响起。
“前辈，什么是毒珠？”
江若尘心中暗问。
“这东西接触无毒，先收下吧，等事后我再告诉你用处。”
老龙道。
“好。”
江若尘反应过来，迅速悄然将珠子收入囊中，而后提起三足毒蟾的尸体走到李柔儿的面前放下。
听到轰的一声，李柔儿才从震惊中回过神来，眼神复杂的看了一眼江若尘，而后就立马拿来了工具，与药童一起小心翼翼的刮下三足毒蟾身上富含剧毒的毒蟾酥，足足有一大罐之多。

“公子，真是谢谢你了，若非你出手，小女子拿不到这一罐毒蟾酥。”
收下毒蟾酥的李柔儿目光如水的跟江若尘表示谢意。
江若尘神情却是淡然：“无须客气，你付钱我办事罢了。”
李柔儿一笑，觉得眼前人有些特别，换做他人这般拿下三足毒蟾，恐怕少不了要一番得意，而江若尘的表现却极为淡然，且不像是故意表现出来的，非常的自然，这不由得让她心中对江若尘的好感再增添了几分。
却也没再多说什么，李柔儿就让伙计拿了一大袋灵石，她亲手交给了江若尘。
江若尘拿到灵石也不避讳，当时就清点了一下。
却发现足足有一百块，比之前说好的六十块酬劳还要多四十块。
注意到江若尘的眼神，李柔儿笑着解释：“公子，小女子能拿到毒蟾酥几乎全靠你出力，这一百灵石还请收下。”
“嗯，谢了。”
听到是格外给的，江若尘也不客气了，此行他确实是出了不少力，外加他真的很缺灵石，才不会故作大气，丢了资源。
拿到了酬劳，江若尘也不做停留了，李柔儿她们要返程，他却还想继续历练一番，也该分开了。
“既然你拿到了毒蟾酥，我们的雇佣关系也就结束了，告辞。”
江若尘抱拳，而后转身便先一步离开了石毒林。
“好熟悉的背影……他到底是什么身份？”
注视着江若尘离开的背影，李柔儿露出了深深的疑惑。
content_en:
Feeling the life breath of the three-legged poison toad disappearing rapidly, everyone showed extremely shocked expressions.
The seriously injured Xiao Zhan's eyes widened, showing an extremely frightened expression.
He himself had fought against the Three-legged Poison Toad. Apart from Jiang Ruochen, he was the one who knew best how strong the Three-legged Poison Toad was.
Although the Three-Legged Poison Toad is at the realm of Tongmai, his combat power has already reached the Qi Sea realm, which is why he was defeated so completely.
But such a powerful monster was killed by Jiang Ruochen with one punch without any hesitation...
What's even more terrifying is that Jiang Ruochen's last punch actually unleashed the power of six elephants. How perverted is this!
At this moment, he was both shocked and ashamed. Thinking about his previous lofty ambitions, they were simply a joke!
On the other side, Jiang Ruochen, who had solved the three-legged poisonous toad, quickly moved the body away and saw what was under its body, which was a bead the size of an egg with a faint green light.
What's this?
Staring at the bead, Jiang Ruochen did not act rashly, because he could feel that although the bead was very beautiful, it was very toxic, and it would be troublesome if it was contaminated.
“It’s really a poisonous pearl!
You kid is really lucky. "
The old dragon's voice sounded at this time.
"Senior, what are poison beads?"
Jiang Ruochen asked secretly in his heart.
"This thing is non-toxic on contact, so keep it for now. I'll tell you its use later."
Old Long said.
"Okay."
Jiang Ruochen reacted, quickly and quietly put the beads into his bag, then lifted the body of the three-legged poison toad and walked to Li Rouer and put it down.
Hearing the bang, Li Rou'er came back from the shock, glanced at Jiang Ruochen with complicated eyes, and then immediately brought the tools, and together with the medicine boy, they carefully scraped off the highly toxic poisonous toad cake from the three-legged poison toad, which was a large jar.
"Master, thank you very much. If you hadn't taken action, the little girl wouldn't have been able to get this jar of poisonous toad cake."
Li Rouer, who accepted the poisonous toad cake, expressed her gratitude to Jiang Ruochen with watery eyes.
Jiang Ruochen's expression was indifferent: "No need to be polite, you pay and I will do the work."
Li Rou'er smiled and felt that the person in front of her was a little special. If someone else had taken down the three-legged poisonous toad like this, he would have felt proud. However, Jiang Ruochen's performance was extremely indifferent and did not appear to be intentional. It was very natural. This could not help but increase her affection for Jiang Ruochen.
But without saying anything else, Li Rouer asked the waiter to bring a large bag of spirit stones, which she handed to Jiang Ruochen herself.
Jiang Ruochen didn't shy away from receiving the spirit stones and counted them immediately.
But he found that it was a full hundred yuan, which was forty yuan more than the sixty yuan promised before.
Noticing Jiang Ruochen's eyes, Li Rou'er smiled and explained: "Sir, the little girl's ability to obtain the Poison Toad Powder depends entirely on your efforts. Please accept these hundred spirit stones."
"Well, thanks."
Jiang Ruochen was not polite when he heard that it was a special gift. He had indeed put in a lot of effort during this trip, and he was really short of spiritual stones, so he would not lose resources by pretending to be grand.
After getting the reward, Jiang Ruochen stopped staying. Li Rouer and the others were about to return, but he still wanted to continue practicing, so it was time to leave.
"Now that you have obtained the Poison Toad Powder, our employment relationship is over. Take your leave."
Jiang Ruochen clasped his fists, then turned around and left the Stone Poison Forest first.
"What a familiar figure... What is his identity?"
Watching Jiang Ruochen's leaving figure, Li Rouer showed deep doubts.
